title: DART Isolated Launch Views
description: Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) Live Launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. The Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) mission is a planetary defense-driven test of technologies for preventing an impact of Earth by a hazardous asteroid. DART is scheduled to launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) on November 23, 2021 at 10:21 p.m. PST. The launch is managed by NASA’s Launch Services Program based at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
